name: compliance-gap-hunter
description: Review ISO 27001:2022 evidence with a clear record of what is supported and what still needs verification.

interface.longDescription: Review ISO 27001:2022 evidence with a clear record of what is supported and what still needs verification. Intended for security, compliance and risk practitioners. It preserves uncertainty and does not replace professional review, an audit, or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Assess these ISO 27001:2022 documents and evidence for gaps.
Show the evidence and uncertainty in this Compliance Gap Hunter review.
Create an action plan from this Compliance Gap Hunter assessment.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package for Compliance Gap Hunter.
